clue.text: Ostentatious and loud, to thrash a child worker

parts.note: F is forte, the musical abbreviation for loud
to lam is to beat or thrash
a boy is a child
an ant is the classic worker insect

explanation.surface: Someone showy and noisy is about to beat a young labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe flamboyant, showy behaviour meant to attract attention.

clue.text: Brush caused by card-game, note

parts.note: loo is an old card game
fah is the fourth note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A row caused by a game of cards and a written note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brush' reads as a skirmish, but it is a bath sponge-scrubber made from a dried gourd.
explanation.definitionFit: A dried gourd skin used in the bath as a scrubber works like a brush.

clue.text: We're not still demonstrating this quality

definitions.text: We're not still demonstrating this quality

parts.words: We're not still demonstrating this quality
parts.note: people who are not still are moving about, displaying the capacity to move

explanation.surface: A speaker admits they no longer show some virtue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not still' looks like 'no longer', but it means 'not motionless'.
explanation.definitionFit: Being able to move freely is the quality shown by anyone who is not still.

clue.text: Describes a sort of slick unctuousness

definitions.text: Describes a sort of slick unctuousness

parts.words: Describes a sort of slick unctuousness
parts.note: slick hints at oil, and unctuousness is greasy flattery; the word describing both is the oily adjective

explanation.surface: A word for smarmy, oily charm.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means oily, and figuratively smarmy or ingratiating, as in an oil slick or slick manner.

clue.text: Chose suitable journalist outside the party

indicators.note: outside says the first pieces stand around the party word

parts.note: apt means suitable
a do is a party
ED is the crossword abbreviation for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: Picked a fitting reporter who stood outside the festivities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' wraps suitable plus journalist around the party; the surface pictures a reporter left outside the festivities.
explanation.definitionFit: To have adopted something, such as a plan, is to have chosen it.

clue.text: Shandy server? A spruce one

definitions.meaning: Corporal ... is the manservant in Sterne's Tristram Shandy
spruce means neat and smart in appearance

explanation.surface: A pub question: who serves the shandy, and is that one neat?
explanation.walkthrough: Corporal Trim is the servant of Uncle Toby in Sterne's novel Tristram Shandy; 'Shandy' looks like the beer and lemonade drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Corporal Trim serves Toby Shandy in Sterne's novel; a spruce person is neat and well kept.

clue.text: What beautiful singing, Enrico!

parts.note: an exclamation to the tenor Enrico Caruso, praising his singing in his own Italian terms

explanation.surface: Applause for the great tenor Caruso.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian phrase for the lyrical operatic style literally means beautiful singing.

clue.text: Calumniators, make doctor earn less

indicators.note: make here means form the letters into something new

explanation.surface: Malicious gossips want a physician's income cut.
explanation.definitionFit: A calumniator spreads false, damaging statements, just as one who defames does.

clue.text: Make a disclosure about meat

parts.note: re means about or concerning
veal is calf meat

explanation.surface: Tell the truth concerning what's on the butcher's slab.
explanation.definitionFit: To disclose is to make something known.

clue.text: It may be felt to be above a Mexican

definitions.text: It may be felt to be above a Mexican

parts.words: It may be felt to be above a Mexican
parts.note: felt is the hat fabric, not a sense of touch; above a Mexican is on his head

explanation.surface: Something one senses hanging over a man from Mexico.
explanation.definitionFit: A wide-brimmed Mexican hat, often made of felt, sits above its wearer.

clue.text: Concentrated information, of course, of Hiawatha's wedding feast

definitions.meaning: a figurative sense: information boiled down into a dense digest

definitions.text: of course, of Hiawatha's wedding feast
definitions.meaning: a dish served at the wedding in Longfellow's poem

explanation.surface: A digest of the facts about the menu at Hiawatha's marriage.
explanation.walkthrough: In Longfellow's The Song of Hiawatha the wedding feast includes this dried meat; 'course' is a course of the meal.
explanation.definitionFit: The dried, pounded meat cake is a byword for condensed matter, and it was served as a course at Longfellow's Hiawatha wedding.

clue.text: One found in Perth, Airdrie and Bangkok?

definitions.text: One found in Perth, Airdrie and Bangkok?

indicators.note: found in says the letters sit inside the run of place names

explanation.surface: Someone who might turn up in two Scottish towns and the Asian capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Perth and Airdrie are Scottish towns; 'found in' picks the letters across their join.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Thailand, whose capital is Bangkok, is one native of that country.

clue.text: A turtle's turn to be so?

definitions.text: A turtle's turn to be so?

parts.words: A turtle's turn to be so?
parts.note: a turtle flipped onto its back is left upside down

explanation.surface: Asking whether it is the reptile's turn to be in some state.
explanation.definitionFit: Upside down and in disorder, as a turtle overturned on its shell.

clue.text: Lack of the quality admired in a sea-going owl

definitions.text: Lack of the quality admired in a sea-going owl

parts.words: Lack of the quality admired in a sea-going owl
parts.note: in Lear's The Owl and the Pussy-cat, the cat calls the seafaring owl an elegant fowl

explanation.surface: Missing what people admire in a bird that goes to sea.
explanation.walkthrough: Edward Lear's owl sails away in a pea-green boat and is praised by the Pussy-cat: 'You elegant fowl!'
explanation.definitionFit: Clumsiness or awkwardness is the absence of grace and style.

clue.text: Commentary on a former appointment

parts.note: ex means former
a position is a post or appointment

explanation.surface: Remarks about a job someone used to hold.
explanation.definitionFit: An explanation or detailed account of a subject is a kind of commentary.

clue.text: A pleasure seeker, young Winslow

definitions.meaning: a man who lives for enjoyment
Rattigan's play The Winslow Boy, read as play plus boy

explanation.surface: A fun-loving lad called Winslow.
explanation.walkthrough: The Winslow Boy is a play by Terence Rattigan, so the young Winslow is the play's boy.
explanation.definitionFit: A wealthy man devoted to pleasure; also, split in two, the boy of Rattigan's play.

clue.text: Describing a standard feature of ancient Rome

definitions.text: Describing a standard feature of ancient Rome

parts.words: Describing a standard feature of ancient Rome
parts.note: the Roman standard was an eagle, and the typical Roman nose is hooked like an eagle's beak

explanation.surface: An adjective for a typical characteristic of the Romans.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means eagle-like, used of a hooked Roman nose; the eagle was Rome's military standard.

clue.text: Summary of bad oriental poem about sex appeal

parts.note: E stands for eastern, oriental

indicators.note: about says the rearranged poem goes around the sex appeal
bad shows the word poem is to be spoilt and rearranged

parts.note: it is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: A digest of a poor eastern verse about allure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' scrambles the poem and 'about' sets the sex appeal inside it; 'oriental' is a standard crossword signal for E, east.
explanation.definitionFit: A concise abstract of a work, a summary, was an old sense of this word.

clue.text: A tropical flower like Murphy? Crazy, to be sure

indicators.note: crazy says the words to be sure are jumbled

explanation.surface: Is a tropical bloom like a potato? Mad, certainly.
explanation.walkthrough: Murphy is slang for a potato, a tuber, hinting at the first part of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mexican plant with fragrant white flowers, grown from a tuberous root.

clue.text: Say, chaps, they're bringing the trunks down

definitions.meaning: an informal spelling of fellows, men
lumberjacks who cut trees to the ground

explanation.surface: A shout to the lads that the timber is coming down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Say' marks a colloquial spelling of fellows.
explanation.definitionFit: A casual word for blokes; also, woodcutters who cut down trees.

clue.text: Juvenile supporters of the Mormon leader?

definitions.text: Juvenile supporters of the Mormon leader?

parts.words: Juvenile supporters of the Mormon leader?
parts.note: Brigham Young led the Mormons, so his followers might be called after his surname

explanation.surface: The teenage followers of a church head.
explanation.definitionFit: Juveniles are young people, children or teenagers.

clue.text: Singer noted for his scales

parts.note: the singer practises musical scales, and the fish of the same name has scales

explanation.surface: A vocalist known for practising runs of notes.
explanation.definitionFit: The lowest male singing voice shares its spelling with a scaly fish.

clue.text: Barker ails badly outside the United Kingdom

indicators.note: outside says the jumbled letters stand around the kingdom
badly shows the word ails is mangled

parts.note: UK is the abbreviation for the United Kingdom

explanation.surface: A dog falls ill abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' scrambles ails and 'outside' wraps that around the kingdom; 'Barker' is a common crossword way of saying dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A barker is a dog, and this is a slender Middle Eastern hunting breed.

clue.text: Terrible to pursue a French student. It's not allowed

indicators.note: to pursue means to follow, so this piece comes after

parts.note: un is French for a
L is the learner plate letter for a student
awful is another word for terrible

explanation.surface: Something dreadful follows a French learner, and it is banned.
explanation.definitionFit: Something not permitted by law is illegal.

clue.text: Crossing in Shakespeare's Windsor

definitions.meaning: a shallow place where a stream can be crossed
a character in The Merry Wives of Windsor

explanation.surface: A river crossing in the town Shakespeare wrote about.
explanation.walkthrough: Master Ford is a jealous husband in The Merry Wives of Windsor.
explanation.definitionFit: A shallow place to wade across a river; also Master Ford of Shakespeare's Merry Wives.

clue.text: A 'good play needs none, said Rosalind as this

definitions.text: A 'good play needs none, said Rosalind as this

parts.words: A 'good play needs none, said Rosalind as this
parts.note: at the close of As You Like It Rosalind says a good play needs no closing speech, while speaking one

explanation.surface: A heroine remarks that a fine drama needs nothing more.
explanation.definitionFit: A closing speech to the audience after a play ends, as Rosalind gives.

clue.text: Like Bede, always somewhat superficial

parts.note: Bede is known as the Venerable Bede, abbreviated Ven
e'er is the poetic short form of ever, always

explanation.surface: The saintly historian is ever a bit shallow.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin decorative layer or a surface show hides what is beneath, so it is superficial.

clue.text: Cut off this In dire trouble

indicators.note: trouble means stir up, so the letters are disturbed

explanation.surface: Removing someone from a will when things are going badly.
explanation.definitionFit: To deprive an heir of an inheritance is to cut them off.
